\subsubsection{Monte Carlo}\label{sss:ampab-mc}

200 samples, process and mismatch together, \SI{37}{\celsius}, under the conditions of
Section~\ref{ss:ampab}. Per-channel yield is the fraction of samples inside the
specification entered on the test; the four-channel figure is its fourth power, the four
channels being nominally identical and assumed independent.

Input offset has a mean of \SI{0.583}{\milli\volt} and \(\sigma =
\SI{5.201}{\milli\volt}\) (Figure~\ref{fig:ampab-mc-voffset},
Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-offset}); against the \(\pm\SI{1}{\milli\volt}\) limit entered
on the test the yield is \SI{12.0}{\percent} per channel and \SI{0.0}{\percent} over
four. In unity-gain feedback the phase margin averages \SI{73.40}{\degree} with a worst
sample of \SI{69.21}{\degree} and the gain margin \SI{8.89}{\decibel} with a worst
sample of \SI{6.98}{\decibel}, so all 200 samples clear the \SI{60}{\degree} and
\SI{6}{\decibel} limits; open-loop gain averages \SI{82.64}{\decibel} in that
configuration (Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-unity}) and \SI{82.16}{\decibel} on the open-loop
bench (Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-openloop}). Output noise integrated \SI{0.1}{\hertz} to
\SI{100}{\kilo\hertz} is \SI{30.44}{\micro\volt} (Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-unity}). Drive
at \SI{50}{\milli\volt} of output error is \SI{2.224}{\milli\ampere} sourcing and
\SI{-2.158}{\milli\ampere} sinking, mean \(\pm\,3\sigma\) of
\(\pm\SI{0.252}{\milli\ampere}\) and \(\pm\SI{0.313}{\milli\ampere}\)
(Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-drive}). Supply current, which covers the amplifier together
with the local bias generator that feeds it, has a median of \SI{122.81}{\micro\ampere}
over a 1st-to-99th percentile range of \SIrange{91.58}{172.09}{\micro\ampere}, for a
median dissipation of \SI{307.0}{\micro\watt} (Figure~\ref{fig:ampab-mc-power},
Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-power}).
